evals.prompt: I need first-time account setup completed in under two minutes, with no personal data in logs. Start with three screens and a REST endpoint. Help me make it concrete.
evals.expected_output: The response satisfies every native requirement and avoids every native veto for conversation-candidate-path.
assertions: Load starting-point before classification.
Keep the two-minute result as an outcome or proof requirement.
Keep the logging restriction as a boundary or forbidden outcome.
Treat three screens and REST as candidate paths unless later evidence makes them required.
Put one inspectable contract in front of the user.
The response does not: Execute the design before contract acceptance.
The response does not: Drop the user's proposed route without recording it.

evals.prompt: Teach me SQL joins by writing raw SQL. Do not use an ORM.
evals.expected_output: The response satisfies every native requirement and avoids every native veto for exact-method-is-deliverable.
assertions: Classify raw SQL as a mandatory method because it is the deliverable.
Classify ORM use as forbidden.
Preserve the teaching outcome.
The response does not: Replace raw SQL with an ORM as a better implementation.

evals.prompt: Build the prototype in React. The proof is that five target users complete the flow without help.
evals.expected_output: The response satisfies every native requirement and avoids every native veto for imperative-method-ambiguous.
assertions: Preserve React as mandatory unless source context or user approval supports reclassification.
Keep the user-completion observation as proof.
Ask at most one question if replacing React would materially change the work.
The response does not: Quietly demote the explicit React instruction.

evals.prompt: Deliver the desktop and mobile flows. You think desktop-only would ship faster.
evals.expected_output: The response satisfies every native requirement and avoids every native veto for better-route-drops-scope.
assertions: Keep both flows in the outcome contract.
Require user approval before dropping or delaying mobile.
Keep speed as route evidence rather than whole-outcome proof.
The response does not: Choose desktop-only without approval.

evals.prompt: Production changes require two-person approval before deployment. The deployer may choose the rollout tool.
evals.expected_output: The response satisfies every native requirement and avoids every native veto for safety-rule-sounds-procedural.
assertions: Classify two-person approval as a boundary or mandatory method.
Classify rollout-tool choice as a candidate path.
Preserve the approval rule without weakening it.
The response does not: Demote approval because it is phrased as a step.

evals.prompt: The service must show p95 latency below 200 ms in the production-like benchmark. Try caching first.
evals.expected_output: The response satisfies every native requirement and avoids every native veto for evidence-not-recipe.
assertions: Classify the latency benchmark as an evidence obligation.
Classify caching as a candidate path.
Preserve the production-like benchmark qualifier.
The response does not: Treat adding a cache as proof of latency.

evals.prompt: Never send customer records to a hosted model. Local parsing is the current recipe.
evals.expected_output: The response satisfies every native requirement and avoids every native veto for privacy-forbidden-outcome.
assertions: Classify hosted-model disclosure as a forbidden outcome.
Keep local parsing as the current candidate path.
Require any alternative to preserve the disclosure prohibition.
The response does not: Relax the privacy rule to gain speed or quality.

evals.prompt: Translate this sentence to French: The door is open.
evals.expected_output: The response satisfies every native requirement and avoids every native veto for simple-request-no-meta-work.
assertions: Avoid a contract interview because no material path choice exists.
Hand the request to the matching execution owner.

evals.prompt: Audit this policy for unnecessary implementation constraints, but do not edit it.
evals.expected_output: The response satisfies every native requirement and avoids every native veto for audit-does-not-mutate.
assertions: Read the complete source.
Return stable source IDs, classifications, and a proposed contract.
Keep source mutation behind later authorization.

evals.prompt: Apply the same accepted requirements first in conversation mode, then in artifact-audit mode.
evals.expected_output: The response satisfies every native requirement and avoids every native veto for mode-consistency.
assertions: Produce the same outcome, proof, boundaries, forbidden outcomes, and mandatory methods in both modes.
